title: Add and verify a custom domain
caption: PF-40, PF-41. Needs FEATURE_CUSTOM_DOMAINS on and a plan with limits.customDomains ≥ 1.

steps.title: Open Domains
steps.expect: Without the switch or the plan: no add form, or "Custom domains are not in your plan".

steps.title: Add
steps.expect: "travel.acme.example was added" with the TXT `_velexis.<host>` record and CNAME (or A/AAAA) options, "Not checked yet", the 72-hour deadline. `tenant_domains` row `pending` with `verification_token`.

steps.title: Copy a record
steps.body: Use the copy button of the TXT value.
steps.expect: Clipboard holds exactly the value; a polite live region announces it.

steps.title: Check now
steps.expect: "Velexis is checking the DNS records … now"; after a reload the last check shows (`txt_missing`, `dns_timeout`…) in words, never the code.

steps.title: Make primary / remove
steps.body: On a verified domain **Make primary**; on any custom domain **Remove**.
steps.expect: One primary per tenant (`is_primary`); removing the primary moves it back to the sub-domain.
